name: tagteam
description: Switch between your own Claude subscription accounts when one runs low.

autoSwitch.title: Switch automatically
autoSwitch.description: Switch to another account on your own when the current one reaches the threshold.

threshold.title: Switch threshold (%)
threshold.description: Usage percentage at which tagteam moves to another account.

stallTimeoutSeconds.title: Stall timeout (seconds)
stallTimeoutSeconds.description: How long to wait for Claude to close on its own after a switch before the launcher closes it.
